Flights of delight and excellent bites

Great choice of tropical and traditional craft beers, nicely curated by the friendly bar staff. May 2023 • Friends
My friend and I visited this place for a beer and burger. The beer tasted suspiciously weaker than when we drank the same drink at another bar. The 'pints' were also had an extremely large amount of head, so they were clearly not the amount of beer we ordered. I wonder why staff are not instructed to fill the glass? A pint is a pint.

Thank you for visiting us and unfortunately didn’t have a great experience. Regarding the price of the vegan burger, the patties need to be imported which makes them more expensive than our in-house made meat patties - our staff should be able to communicate this and we will retrain our team to better handle these questions going forward.

Malt South at D7: grills, brunches and drinks done right! Environmental takeaway packaging too!
Jun 2022
Great authentic grills:
- ribs and wings were juicy and tender
- cheeses were melted to perfection
- corn on the cob was large and juicy
Nailed 'em all. Nailed the accompanying sauces and veggie dips too.

Brunches:
- benedicts, pancakes, burritos, avo toasts, brioche, sourdough, English muffins, refried beans, patties, guacamole... whatever you've missed about Western breakfasts, they've got a-plenty options of them for you to choose from.
- might get crowded on the weekends so come early? 
- plenty of drinks to make this your regular watering hole

Takeaways/Delivery:
- Never disappoints.
- Well packed in mostly paper/foil packaging. 
- Always piping hot despite traveling a distance.

Also good for:
- pies, soups, kiddy food and drinks.

Malt South, Sister Restaurant of Malt in D7
Jan 2021
I wanted to write a review of Malt South in District 7 but unfortunately I cannot find it listed in Trip Advisor. Knowing that Malt is a sister restaurant of Malt South, in D1, I decided to write the review here. Malt South is a place to which we go regularly, with super friendly, welcoming staff and it is usually at least half full each night which gives it a great vibe. We very much enjoy the pork ribs, especially with the corn on the cob, salad and the coleslaw. I must say that the coleslaw is the best tasted anywhere. Malt South also makes a delicious spicy cauliflower dish as well. In addition, my husband loves the prawns in chili and garlic sauce which he says are wonderful. Finally, another favourite of mine is the chili con carne on fries. There is a slight sweetness to the meat which I don't particularly like but a few extra chilis and generously added salt soon takes care of that. The fries are crisp and tasty. The only concern I have had is sometimes in the past this dish has been a little warm as opposed to hot, or the French fries have been hot but the meat just warm. However over time of asking if the waitress can ask the chef to send the whole dish out piping hot, it is now to a supper hot temperature on a regular basis. The wines there are very good, especially the Italian and the frozen Bellinis are the best in town. It is a treat to pop into Malt South from time to time.

Looked Like a Hangout for Western Expat Degenerates
Jan 2021
When I was there recently some guy in his mid/late-20s (who acted like he owned the place) lit up a marijuana joint in the outside seating area. There were other customers nearby who were bothered by this and it is understandable. Normal people do not want to be poisoned with marijuana. The smell also stays in your clothes until they are washed. The waitresses knew the guy was smoking pot. She acted like it was completely fine. It was obvious but she did nothing. It was also obvious the kid was a regular. I was shocked and disgusted. If I want to be around druggies I'll hang out at Bui Vien. Public consumption of drugs is totally not acceptable in this area of Saigon, not to mention being very illegal. Note to owner: if you want druggies and degenerates as customers, you're doing a fine job. But if you prefer higher-class patrons, you are far off the target. A place does not have to be ritzy to be frequented by upper income clientele. The most important thing we seek is a safe, decent place where no illegal activity is permitted. I don't think that's raising the bar too high, or is it?
